# DPS Midtjylland

DPS Midtjylland is a psychiatric organisation named in the annual reports of the Danish [[adhd-databasen|ADHD-databasen]], the national quality registry for ADHD diagnosis and treatment [^src1] [^src2]. It appears in both the 2023 and 2024 editions of the report, where it is identified as part of the "formandskab" (chairmanship/board) that administers the registry alongside senior physicians ("overlæger") from [[aarhus-universitetshospital|Aarhus Universitetshospital]] [^src1] [^src2].

The 2023 report, covering the period leading up to and including that year, lists DPS Midtjylland as a body represented in the registry's governing chairmanship, which is responsible for overseeing the documentation of ADHD diagnostic and treatment quality across Danish child and adolescent psychiatry [^src1]. The 2024 report — covering the period from 1 April 2023 to 31 March 2024 and produced by the Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram (RKKP) and, per its own account, published by Sundhedsvæsenets Kvalitetsinstitut under the leadership of Shelagh Powell and Simon Hjerrild — again names DPS Midtjylland in this same governance role [^src2].

Beyond its place in the registry's leadership, DPS Midtjylland's home region features directly in the substance of the 2024 findings. The report notes that "I region midt har der været særligt fokus på registreringspraksis samt en prøvehandling med forkortede udredningsforløb" — that is, Region Midt has been a particular focus area for improving registration practices and for piloting shortened diagnostic assessment ("udredning") pathways [^src2]. This sits within a broader national picture the report describes: Danish child and adolescent psychiatry facing rising referral numbers, longer waiting times, and declining performance against most quality indicators, even as the 2024 report — for the first time — also incorporates data from the adult population and from private hospitals [^src2].

No relationships or discrete claims beyond these mentions are recorded for DPS Midtjylland in the corpus. Its significance, as documented, rests on its formal representation in the chairmanship overseeing the ADHD-databasen's quality reporting [^src1] [^src2].
